Interface LanguageModel

All Known Implementing Classes:
GenAiChatModel, Llama, Qwen
public interface LanguageModel
Common façade for chat-capable decoder LLMs (Llama, Qwen, …).

Implementations load a checkpoint, expose chat-template encoding, and run autoregressive generation for a single prompt. Concurrent multi-request scheduling belongs in InferenceEngine, not on this interface.

Streaming and metrics use a single optional GenerationListener. Transport-specific types such as SubmissionPublisher belong at the serve boundary (see GenerationListeners.toPublisher(SubmissionPublisher)).

Cooperative cancel: pass a non-null cancelRequested supplier; the implementation checks it between decode steps and throws CancellationException when true (KV is still unbound in finally).

    • generate

      default ChatCompletion generate(int[] prompt, int maxGenLen, double temperature, double topp, boolean logprobs, long seed, GenerationListener listener)
      Generates a completion from an already-tokenized prompt (no cancel).
      Parameters:
      prompt - prompt token id sequence.
      maxGenLen - maximum number of new tokens to generate.
      temperature - sampling temperature.
      topp - nucleus-sampling top-p threshold.
      logprobs - whether to include per-token log-probabilities.
      seed - RNG seed; 0 means non-deterministic.
      listener - optional progress callback; may be null.
      Returns:
      the completion for prompt.

    • generate

      ChatCompletion generate(int[] prompt, int maxGenLen, double temperature, double topp, boolean logprobs, long seed, GenerationListener listener, BooleanSupplier cancelRequested)
      Generates a completion from an already-tokenized prompt.
      Parameters:
      prompt - prompt token id sequence.
      maxGenLen - maximum number of new tokens to generate (not including the prompt itself).
      temperature - sampling temperature; higher values increase randomness.
      topp - nucleus-sampling top-p threshold in (0, 1].
      logprobs - true to include per-token log-probabilities in the result.
      seed - optional RNG seed for deterministic sampling; 0 means non-deterministic.
      listener - optional progress callback; may be null.
      cancelRequested - when non-null and returns true, generation stops between decode steps with CancellationException.
      Returns:
      the completion for prompt.

    • chat

      ChatCompletion chat(Message[] dialog, int maxGenLen, double temperature, double topp, boolean logprobs, long seed, GenerationListener listener, BooleanSupplier cancelRequested)
      Generates an assistant reply for a dialog.

      Equivalent to encodeChat(Message...) followed by generate(int[], int, double, double, boolean, long, GenerationListener).

      Parameters:
      dialog - ordered conversation turns.
      maxGenLen - maximum number of new tokens to generate.
      temperature - sampling temperature; higher values increase randomness.
      topp - nucleus-sampling top-p threshold in (0, 1].
      logprobs - true to include per-token log-probabilities in the result.
      seed - optional RNG seed for deterministic sampling; 0 means non-deterministic.
      listener - optional progress callback; may be null.
      cancelRequested - cooperative cancel flag; may be null.
      Returns:
      the completion for dialog.
